description: This file declares functions related to Zigbee telemetry management, including initialization, shutdown, and property configuration.

methods.name: zigbeeTelemetryInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the Zigbee Telemetry system, potentially starting network captures.

methods.name: zigbeeTelemetryShutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the Zigbee Telemetry system, stopping any running captures and releasing resources.

methods.name: zigbeeTelemetrySetProperty
methods.description: Updates a Zigbee telemetry related property which could start, stop, or change a running capture's configuration.
